findings.title: New SDK item-ID default conflicts with existing stateless history projection
findings.cause: 2.66send_item_ids defaults from supports_encrypted_reasoning_content; disabling supports_reasoning_context no longer suppresses assistant itemIDs. SDK emits structured assistant output-message replay rejected by exact current adapter.
findings.minimalAdaptation: Set public model setting openai_send_reasoning_ids=False explicitly on delegate. It is supported by both2.37and2.66 and preserves the intended idless/stateless history contract; no broader unvalidated item parser required.
findings.isolatedProof: Process-local constructor settings injection only; both unchanged deferred history cases passed in1.59s including msg_read_status.

findings.title: SDK stream normalization hides phase changes from existing guard
findings.cause: 2.66emits phase metadata only once per content part using _phase_started_content. Same wire itemID later changing final_answer to commentary becomes invisible to capture_events and commentary may be exposed as final text.
findings.minimalAdaptation: Reject contradictory raw output-item phase identity in bounded SSE compatibility adapter before SDK normalization. Keep existing framework event checks and unchanged negative criterion. Validate absent/changed phases, separateIDs, tool/text mixing and terminal/cleanup paths.
findings.isolatedProof: Process-local rawattestor immutable itemphase map only; unchanged negative testcase passed in1.70s, asserting preview onlyHoi and one request.

modularity.currentCoupling: Runner imports _InputBudgetError,_ProviderUnavailable,_ProviderUsageError from large concrete PydanticConversationModel module to classify neutral work outcomes. Public model/contracts.py already houses the corresponding shared error contract boundary.
modularity.boundedRecommendation: Place three descriptive provider-neutral public exception classes in existing model/contracts.py and use that single definition from adapter and runner. Preserve model_usage, exact status classifications and never match exception messages. No new registry/platform or whole-adapter rewrite.
modularity.deploymentCaution: Runner source and shared provider are release/profile-bound; any such refactor needs scoped tests and exact core/worker/digital profiles to match before deployment.
